title: To the SWAFL project: the last step of the path
intro: The last step takes the results to the layers of the SWAFL project. Daisy calculates; the SWAFL project turns the results into decisions. For each of the five questions the tab offers the layers that answer it, and the button of the question you ran last is highlighted. The runs you made in the session are passed to the layers, so they show your weather and your soil.

marks.d: The last step of the path.
Opens the layer that matches the question you ran last.
Yield, water and nitrate of every run, answer by answer.
Decay, crop uptake, leaching, runoff and what stays in the soil.
Supply, uptake and losses of nitrogen, season by season.
How steady the result is from year to year.
